suggested_experiment_name: PPPA (Parkes Pulsar Polarization Array, PPTA DR3)
coupling_convention: g_agamma (ALDM Chern-Simons photon coupling) in GeV^-1, converted from the plotted log10(g_agamma/GeV^-1) axis
notes: First pulsar polarization array (PPA) analysis using 22 MSPs from PPTA DR3, constraining ALDM-induced cosmic birefringence via the axion-photon Chern-Simons coupling. Paper states 95% upper limits of gaγγ ≲ 10^-13.5 to 10^-12.2 GeV^-1 over the fuzzy-DM mass range 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV, assuming local ALDM density ρ0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Data points encode the two endpoints of this stated range (limits scale roughly linearly with ma for ma ≳ 1/Tobs). Full exclusion curve spans ~10^-23 to ~10^-19 eV (Fig. 2) but only the quoted text values are extractable; no numerical table provided. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 55)) | Vision: Traced the red solid 'Full-corr' curve in FIG. 2 (95% CL upper limits on g_agamma from the PPPA, rho_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3). Boundary scales ~m^-2 below 1/T_obs (T_obs ~ 18 yr, minimum g ~ 1.3e-14 at m ~ 6e-24 eV), rises ~linearly with m above 1/T_obs, has a feature near m ~ 1e-22 eV, a rough plateau at ~3e-12 GeV^-1 for m ~ 1e-20 to 4e-20 eV, then oscillates strongly with sharp peaks (e.g. at the 1-day timescale, m ~ 5e-20 eV) up to the right edge. High-mass (m > 5e-20 eV) points follow strong oscillations and are less precise. Reference lines: CAST at ~6e-11, SN1987A at ~5.6e-12, Chandra H1821+643 at ~5.6e-13 GeV^-1.
